Represents a single page in the `webwriter-pages` widget.
Single-media pages remove padding and fit media without stretching or cropping.

declarations.description:
Display authored content as pages, with tabs by default or a preview-card layout.

Authors add `webwriter-page` children; the `type` attribute switches between the Slides view with preview cards ("pages")
and the default tab strip ("tabs"). Thumbnails are drawn in the editor with a capture library that loads on first use.
In use mode the arrow keys, the controls and swipes in fullscreen move between pages. The arrow keys leave
text entry, Alt and Meta combinations alone. Every thumbnail and tab has a button that selects its page;
in edit mode Space or Enter on the thumbnail itself picks it up for reordering.

Set `orientation="portrait"` for a 9:16 page, or use the default `landscape` for 16:9. The orientation applies to both views, fullscreen, and preview cards. The attribute is optional; an absent attribute keeps landscape without adding it to existing markup.

The widget follows the page theme: `--ww-text-color`, `--ww-font-family`, and `--ww-theme-accent-1` (the
selected thumbnail). On paper it prints all pages one after another and leaves out the controls.

Conversions: a `section` becomes pages (its nested `section` children become one page each, otherwise the
section is one page). Each page converts to a `details` element with its label as the summary.
The thumbnails are not carried over.

Signals: `page` is the number of the current page, starting at 1; `count` is the number of pages.
Both change when readers or authors move to another page.

Known limitation: in edit mode the drag module sets `touch-action: none` on the thumbnails, so on a touch
screen the thumbnail strip cannot be scrolled by dragging on a thumbnail; the select buttons still work.

members.name: type
members.description:
Defines the type of view for the sequence of pages.
- "pages": Show the Slides view with preview cards.
- "tabs": Show content using tabs.

members.name: orientation
members.description: Page orientation: 16:9 landscape or 9:16 portrait. The optional orientation attribute defaults to landscape when absent; the default is not added to existing markup.

members.name: pages
members.description:
All `webwriter-page` elements.
Represents the individual pages in the sequence of pages.

members.name: activePageIndex
members.description: Index of the currently active page.

members.name: signals
members.description: Public signals: the current page number (from 1) and the number of pages.

members.name: actions
members.description: The drawer declarations with the availability of the page actions, which follows the pages.

members.name: activePage
members.description: The active page element based on the activePageIndex.

members.name: hasNextPage
members.description: False if sequence of pages is on the last page.

members.name: hasPreviousPage
members.description: False if sequence of pages is on the first page.

members.name: isFullscreen
members.description: Whether the sequence of pages is currently displayed in fullscreen mode.

members.name: loadSections
members.description: Replaces the pages with the pages a `section` stands for; declines anything else.

members.name: toDetails
members.description: One `details` per page with its label as summary; `null` without pages.

members.name: addPage
members.description: Add a new empty page element. Optionally insert after given index.

members.name: duplicatePage
members.description: Duplicate an existing page at given index.

members.name: removeActivePage
members.description: Remove the currently active page element.

members.name: removePage
members.description: Remove a page and return editor selection to the surviving active page's start.

members.name: nextPage
members.description: Activate the next page element.

members.name: #handleSelectionChange
members.description: Follows the selection to the page that contains it.

members.name: #handleKeyDown
members.description:
Handles keyboard navigation for the sequence of pages.
ArrowRight advances to the next page, ArrowLeft goes back.
Only possible in preview mode.

members.name: #takesText
members.description: Whether the element is a place where arrow keys move a caret or a value.

members.name: #handleTouchStart
members.description:
Handles the start of a touch event for swipe navigation.
Records the initial touch position and target element.
Only active in fullscreen mode.

members.name: #isInteractiveTarget
members.description:
Determines if the given element or any of its ancestors (up to the sequence of pages container) is an interactive element.
Used to prevent swipe navigation when interacting with widgets or interactive elements.

members.name: #handleTouchEnd
members.description:
Handles the end of a touch event for swipe navigation.
Determines the swipe direction and navigates to the next or previous page accordingly.
Ignores swipes on interactive elements or if the swipe distance is too small.

members.name: handleNextPageClick

parameters.name: e
parameters.description: The triggering mouse or keyboard event.

parameters.name: backwards
parameters.description: Whether to navigate backward (default is false).

members.description:
Handles navigation to the next or previous page based on user input.
- Shift key: jump by the total number of pages.
- Ctrl key: jump by 10 pages.
- Otherwise: move by one page.

members.name: changePage
members.description:
Changes the active page to the specified index.
Waits for rendering to finish, scrolls the active page into view,
and generates a thumbnail preview.

parameters.description: The index of the page to activate.
parameters.name: index

members.name: onDragCommit
members.description:
Moves the dragged page to the place the drop resolved to.
The thumbnails and tabs stand for the authored `webwriter-page` children,
so the commit moves the page itself and the lifted item settles at the new layout.

members.name: #view
members.description: The sequence of pages as seen by the strip and control components.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description:
Defines the type of view for the sequence of pages.
- "pages": Show content as sequential pages.
- "tabs": Show content using tabs.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Page orientation: 16:9 landscape or 9:16 portrait. The optional orientation attribute defaults to landscape when absent; the default is not added to existing markup.
